summary: Implemented an ask_user tool that renders inline in the chat as a question card. The tool appends a 'Write my own answer…' sentinel option to select requests that triggers a free-text input request, while pure input requests get a free-text field directly. Backend and frontend tests were added, prettier/svelte-check/typecheck pass, and the work was committed as 50b7e67.
decisions: Select answers are validated server-side against offered options, so free text for selects goes through the tool's sentinel option + follow-up input request rather than bypassing validation.
Confirmations (ctx.ui.confirm) and editors stay modal dialogs; only select/input requests render inline in chat.
ask_user is a Gizmo-provided tool (not a Pi extension) since it's a shell UI capability like the bridge itself.
Question card renders in Conversation between message list and composer, not globally via AppDialogs — acceptable since users are watching the thread during streaming.
Removed the inline 'Write my own answer…' free-text form from the select path in the card because the tool already appends the sentinel option to the options list.
errors: TypeScript TS2352 error on tool.execute cast in ask-user-tool.test.ts: the direct cast to a 3-arg signature failed because Pi's execute overload signature doesn't sufficiently overlap. Fixed by changing the cast to `as unknown as (...)`.
